entities.summary: Kevin Padian is an American paleontologist and evolutionary biologist. He is Professor of Integrative Biology and Curator of the Museum of Paleontology Emeritus at the University of California, Berkeley, where he taught from 1980 to 2020. Padian's research focuses on vertebrate evolution, especially the origins of flight, the paleobiology of pterosaurs, the emergence of dinosaurs across the Triassic-Jurassic boundary, the evolution of birds from theropod dinosaurs, the growth dynamics of dinosaurs and related fossil reptiles, and the interpretation of fossilized footprints.
